text: The Nominating Panel - Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal must select candidates to interview at its next meeting for appointment to the Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal. Following the interviews, the Nominating Panel will recommend five candidates, including a Chair, to City Council for appointment to the Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal.

The Nominating Panel - Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview at its next meeting for appointment to the Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: - Candidate DDR1-111 - Candidate DDR1-129 - Candidate DDR1-131 - Candidate DDR1-146 - Candidate DDR1-147 - Candidate DDR1-148 - Candidate DDR1-152 - Candidate DDR1-153 - Candidate DDR1-155 - Candidate DDR1-156 - Candidate DDR1-157 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (April 3, 2023) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals who are being considered for appointment to the Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal.
